name: TraceLens focus loop
brief: Animate the selected option C exactly: unequal soft black brackets around a small rounded square. Preserve the original drawing through clipped raster layers. The brackets focus gently inward, the center pulses and tilts by four degrees, then all return to the resting pose. Pure black and white, no sound, no text.

content.customize: Preserve the selected raster geometry. Translate brackets by about ten output pixels each; pulse the center to 110% with a four-degree tilt.

beats.action: Brackets move inward; center gently pulses and tilts
Hold the original logo for a seamless repeat
